articles.title: Hunt Energy Spinout Watter Puts AI Computing in Hyatt Regency Dallas, Turns Server Heat Into Hot Water
articles.summary: Dallas-based AI infrastructure startup Watter just rolled out a waste-heat-to-water platform for commercial buildings. Its first customer: Hyatt Regency Dallas at Reunion Tower. Watter’s hardware captures heat from computer servers inside a commercial building and converts it to hot water for the building. …

articles.summary: Tesla’s autonomous ride-hailing Cybercabs — which aren’t equipped with a steering wheel, accelerator pedal, brake pedal or rearview mirrors — will soon hit the streets of Dallas. articles.title: Patented: 7-Eleven’s Item-Recognition Tech and 121 More Inventions Across North Texas
articles.summary: Irving-based 7-Eleven added to its intellectual property with a pair of patents the week of Sept. 29. The patents relate to its ongoing work on inventory tracking and computer-vision item recognition. One patent improves data prediction in systems that track when items are removed from locations.…
